title: Pan’s hour, the faunal noon. Among gumheavy serpentplants, milkoozing fruits, where on the tawny waters leaves lie wide. Pain is far.
html_source: Stephen may be modeling himself on a figure in a contemporary poem ‘L'après-midi d'un faune’ (The after-noon of a faun) by Stéphane Mallarmé.
